newly_read_complete_immune_decisions.concrete_observation: 独立原生控制状态改变与按目标成功回执家族1：永久AI结构改写+已改变才声光/付费+实体重载恢复；区别GuardianHeart短期随机setTarget和既账Diva延迟记仇优先级。这不是Boss免疫拒控。每tick即便mana不足，先无条件setCurrentFuseTime(2)和setTarget(null)；Accessor字段实际swell，不能把注释函数名误作已经延迟爆炸2tick。成功只指goal结构修改，不证明永不爆炸或完全停止反击，别的AI/点火仍未穷尽。相同目标已改完didfalse不再付费/成功声光，属于状态改变去重不是时间CD；卸载重载有标记重建但不补播成功。删除精确Player目标类，不涵盖Player子类/所有其他目标；预装避人Goal缺失时仅移除目标Goal也可didtrue。当前world实体ID定位缺UUID/维度/序号，粒子用收包时当前位置快照、非随后追踪。
newly_read_complete_immune_decisions.application_to_boss_immune: Boss免控必须以最终拒绝原因产生灰字，不能拿改AI成功或花的粒子作免疫；可借鉴目标状态改变去重、重载静默恢复、资源扣费/回执和目标身份的分离。普通阴阳体质仍无灰字门槛。
newly_read_complete_immune_decisions.limitations: 所列完整方法及Goal/能力保存/Forge注册已人工读；新增固定资源3份树blob通过。blockEvent的原版队列合并/半径/目标ID复用、实体引擎目标事件与避人Goal执行内部、音源文件和Sparkle实际render/depth/寿命未完整展开，不宣称已可见或成功控制/TCP/运行mixin。大型注册只把实际包含方法及相关声明做支持0，不按文件/包装计数。ForgeSpecialFlowerBlock正常花实际转发已读；漂浮变体无单独成功回执证明，不冒称所有形态通过。无正式改动/游戏/编译。

newly_read_complete_immune_decisions.full_chain_observation:
Fixed real entity registry creates Vallumraptor, attribute subscriber binds its attributes, ClientProxy binds VallumraptorRenderer, and complete mod constructor registers entity registry and CommonEvents on event bus. Registry/proxy reads are bounded binding declarations rather than claimed full containing initializers.
Complete native subclass defines HIDING_FOR sync integer default0, local hideProgress/prevHideProgress, and local fleeTicks/fleeFromPosition. In tick, after super.tick, hideProgress moves +1 toward20 while hideFor>0 and -1 toward0 after <=0. Health recovery requests heal2 on entity tick modulo15 while hiding versus100 otherwise, provided below max; this has no surrounding server-only guard.
Server-only block decrements positive hideFor by1 and positive relaxed timer; fleeTicks decrements in another server-only block. Later tick code, outside those explicit guards, examines its own current target: nonnull/alive/notcreativePlayer. If tame, health<max*.45 and hideFor<=0, chooses80..119, writes hideFor, fleeFromPosition=target position and fleeTicks=same i. If that current threat is Mob, requests setTarget(null), setLastHurtByMob(null) and setLastHurtMob(null).
Fresh hiding is not directly qualified by current hurt success. Its entire trigger is native tick state, and because countdown decrement precedes the trigger, expiration may immediately re-enter if lowHP/tame/threat still qualify. There is no separate hide-rearm cooldown or attack-attempt lease consumption in this complete subclass.
Complete CommonEvents.livingFindTarget cancels LivingChangeTarget when the new target is this class with hideFor>0, first requesting mob.setTarget(null). Complete livingTick also server-clears a Mob current target when it is a hiding Vallumraptor. The recurring sweep only clears target; the broader revenge/lastHurt clearing belongs to the selected threat at entry, not every observer.
Registered embedded FleeGoal requires positive fleeTicks and nonnull flee origin; tick sets running and navigates away only when current navigation is done, with hide-dependent search span4 versus8. stop nulls fleeFromPosition and sets running false; it does not clear hideFor or explicitly stop navigation. The hide countdown, flee timer, goal lifecycle and graphic progress are separate state lifetimes.
Complete own NBT methods save/load Elder, RelaxedTime and JustLootedChest while delegating super. There are no own HIDING_FOR/fleeTicks/flee origin/hideProgress keys; no durable hide lease/reload restoration is asserted. Natural expiry lets numeric hide reach0; visual progress fades independently and can still be positive after the target refusal condition ends.
Complete renderer.scale sets model alpha to1-.9*interpolatedHideProgress, nominally .1 at full progress rather than invisible. getRenderType uses hideProgress(1)>0 to force entityTranslucent; actual model setter and complete renderToBuffer multiply alphaIn by stored alpha. This graphic gate is not the integer hideFor>0 admission gate. Held ItemLayer renders its item without passing that model alpha or testing hideFor, so matching held-object fade is not established.
Complete own melee goal has no hideFor check in canUse/checkAndDealDamage; canUse instead checks live target, not dancing, not creativePlayer, and outbound damage still depends on LOS/range. Higher-priority FleeGoal uses MOVE and may affect scheduling, so this is not a claim attacks always run during hiding. Neither graphical fade nor target-event cancellation proves damage immunity or universal AI/control refusal.
No custom per-refusal text, reason packet, per-attempt flash or rejection sound occurs in the read target refusal listeners. Body alpha is state presentation. Existing generic eating/ambient/attack sounds and entity event45 are not refusal acknowledgments.
Numeric hideFor is the AI-target refusal gate. Local interpolated hideProgress is a separate graphic lifetime; progress updates before numeric decrement, so fading or translucent body does not establish current protection.
Low-health trigger requires tame, retained live noncreative threat and nonpositive timer. Recovery requests occur earlier and may change eligibility; renewal is conditional, not guaranteed or a forever-safe state.
Flee origin/timer are shared with chest theft and the separate wild-prey escape branch. afterSteal can replace them with a different origin and longer timer, so fleeing and hiding cannot be treated as one inseparable lease.
Only the entry-selected threat receives revenge/last-hurt clear requests. The registered recurring Mob sweep clears only current target. The protected entity own melee predicate has no hide gate, but MOVE priority matters.
Complete own subclass has no hide-specific hurt override. Bounded Dinosaur base identity/initialization reading does not prove absence of inherited or other listener protections. No universal damage or control immunity claimed.
Coordinator reread every proposed source range, complete entity/renderer/melee and complete two target listeners; large registry/proxy ranges are limited binding declarations. Only alpha declaration and complete setter/render methods of model were read, not whole model/art. Six prior substantive decision records read, not six source chains.

prior069_complete_nucleeper_judgment_reu.full_chain_observation:
Actual mod constructor binds registry and client setup; deferred NUCLEEPER factory and attributes plus actual renderer registration exist. Research does not claim natural spawn deployment or installed runtime/API compatibility.
Complete registerGoals registers higher priority AvoidEntityGoal Raycat radius10 with tick calling super then catScareTime=20; MeleeGoal requires live target and moves to it, triggering within3.5+target width without explicit LOS/trigger reset on leaving. AvoidEntityGoal/GoalSelector engine admission internals not expanded, so not every cat in radius is proven to renew fear. Player igniter-tag interaction separately triggers on server, requests item hurtAndBreak and side-success; no successful item-cost or creative-consumption proof.
While triggered and server, positive fear and !EXPLODING decrements positive CloseTime; only a subsequent evaluation at nonpositive time clears TRIGGERED. Otherwise it increments time until configured fuse, then alive permits EXPLODING=true. Fear decrements later in own tick. It is a renewable goal-written counter, not per-attacker/source throttling or an actual successful damage counter. A target may re-trigger through own AI; stopping one attempt is not persistent threat removal.
When EXPLODING alreadytrue the fear-decrement branch is disabled. Own tick advances separate local explodeProgress to5 then calls discard on either side, and on server calls explode only when transient spawnedExplosion false, setting true after method returns. Own class has no normal clear-EXPLODING path, but no global irreversibility, cross-mod absence, absolute wall-clock deadline or exactly-once successful explosion is proved.
explode creates registered NuclearExplosion without null guard after own discard, copies position and size1/1.75, requests noGrief when mobGriefing false and ignores addFreshEntity bool. Failed/null creation or add may leave no live emitted entity despite prior removal/warning. Local guard prevents a repeated returned call on that object; it is not durable exactly-once settlement.
NBT writes Charged and CloseTime only; own TRIGGERED/EXPLODING/catScareTime/progress/spawnedExplosion are not saved here. A reconstructed instance can retain positive CloseTime but default untriggered/nonexploding; source visual branch only needs positive progress/alive/notexploding, so persisted time and armed-state indicators can diverge. No live save/reload or all external state restoration proof.
closeProgress uses time sampled before current increment/decrement; sirenAngle uses previous closeProgress before new ratio. Progress not explicitly clamped, angle adds modulo increment rather than clamping total angle. Config declared default300/min20/maxINT; actual loaded config and arbitrary NBT values unverified. Ratios outside expected range cannot be universally excluded.
Renderer emits rotating green warning geometry only closeProgress>0,alive,!EXPLODING; uses sqrtprogress*3 length and(1-sqrtprogress)*1.25 width. It does not additionally test TRIGGERED. Model setup moves head/cores by progress and compresses base by explodeProgress; exact model offsets map warning origin. No pixel/art/frame registration/pose evaluation native acceptance; geometry design is not independently counted.
Glow sinusoidal alpha nominal0.5..1 is not trigger/refusal-specific; button texture cycles tick/5 vs charged tick/2. Explosion overlay alpha tracks separate explodeProgress. Alpha eyes explicitly EQUAL depth, warning light render type no explicit depth-test setting and different output target; do not claim wall penetration or same depth policy. Charged layer adapter delegates power gating to unexpanded native EnergySwirlLayer, not new immune mechanics.
ClientProxy admits entity sound only client, caches case1 by integer entity ID and validates class/isSameEntity helper before reuse, queues only !isSoundPlaying&&canPlaySound. Nucleeper.remove calls clearSoundCacheFor, whose body only removes map entry; this does not by itself prove running sound stop. Actual NucleeperSound is absent, so helper identity, volume/pitch, mute/stop and stopped-instance behavior not verified. No audible sound was played.
Triggered server periodically requests nearby siren POIs on(tickCount+id)%10==0 within256; then instance check calls setNearestNuclearBomb. Interface shouldStopBlaringSirens returns(!triggered&&!exploding)||removed. Actual NuclearSirenBlockEntity and NuclearSirenSound absent: no proof nearest/range/fairness/save/renewal/stop/audio. Requests and interface contract are bounded only.
Emitted NuclearExplosion full tick/removal/serialization read: noGrief gates world block work, not outer living-entity damage/effect/motion loop. The latter is not explicitly server-guarded in this class, ignores hurt/addEffect results and assigns delta movement independent of hurt success. Raycat damage becomes0 but effect is still requested and velocity is set from zero damage; radiation-resistant tag and Tremorzilla special branches depend on actual tag data not loaded here. This is contextual sink behavior, no new immunity-family credit.
Full explosion class requests chunk loading/unloading server-side and only saves WasLoadingChunks; size/noGrief/intentional flags and destroying stack not saved here. create/add/body feedback do not prove world damage, successful effects or safe reload. Its block-carving and egg transformation side paths are supporting context0; no architecture/ecology/native material credit.
One adjacent counterplay/anticipation feedback family, not a hurt/control-immunity implementation: externally renewed avoidance lease reverses an existing local countdown before EXPLODING; warning state, preparation cancellation and emitted entity outcome remain distinct.
Native AvoidEntityGoal is now read complete: combat targeting plus range/selection, random away position, not-closer check and a nonnull path gate admission. Continuation checks navigation unfinished, not current cat distance or liveness. Scheduler timing and successful navigation remain unexpanded; fear20 is refreshed only when this registered anonymous goal actually ticks.
EXPLODING disables the fear rollback branch, not every later mutable operation. Local explodeProgress reaches5 only on a later evaluation after the flag was set. Discard occurs before create/add; create is unchecked and returned add result is ignored. No durable exactly-once explosion is asserted.
NucleeperSound complete source now proves canPlay checks silent+triggered, while tick checks alive+triggered but not silent and does not explicitly stop on EXPLODING. Own remove clears cache; sound tick separately requests stop when no longer alive/triggered. The cache identity is alive+integer ID only, not UUID or dimension; case1 lacks old.isStopped recreation guard, so reusing a stopped matching instance is possible in source, not a tested restart failure.
Sound progress can be stale versus current countdown: time sampled before this tick update; sirenAngle uses previous progress; neither ratio nor sqrt input is clamped. Ordinary valid default progress is not proof arbitrary persisted CloseTime/config always produces finite bounded pitch/geometry.
Siren complete block installs ticker; state owner computes powered/volume before clearing stale bomb pointer. setNearestNuclearBomb replaces only a closer pointer, does not reject inactive/removed input first and holds no list of alternatives. Clearing one does not promote a farther source without another request. These are exact call-order boundaries, not a measured missed alarm.
Siren bomb pointer itself is not persisted; integer BombID and optional furnace coordinates are. load/getUpdateTag/packet apply do not resolve bomb identity; missing BombID getInt yields0 and omitted furnace coordinates do not explicitly clear an existing field. Constructor volume reflects POWERED only, not a loaded BombID. Server clearing/re-requests and native network/save order were not run.
BlockEntityTickableSound uses looping+linear attenuation and position-only helper identity. ClientProxy case0 recreates stopped objects whereas entity case1 does not. NuclearSirenSound tick updates volume until block removal, including zero volume after deactivation; canPlay is an admission test, not its tick stop predicate. No audible or engine scheduler guarantee.
Emitted explosion noGrief only gates block work. Living scan has no explicit server guard; hurt/effect results are unchecked and velocity set separately. Query is a box, and calculateDamage is unclamped, so negative damage-derived inward velocity outside spherical maximum is possible by source arithmetic; no reproduced motion or damage result. Raycat suppression does not cancel effect request.
Distinct from nonrenewing refused-hit refractory wake windows, coalesced refusal charge, successful-hurt cooldown retaliation, committed NPC/victim ritual, animation phase denial, attack-attempt release, permanent goal rewrite and combat-revoked offhand pacification. Ten selected actual substantive decision fields were read, not all461 decisions or their old source chains.
